# Virtuves pēc pasūtījuma

> Virtuves pēc pasūtījuma projektē, izgatavo, piegādā un uzstāda individuālas virtuves klientu mājokļiem Rīgā un 19 citās apstiprinātās apkalpošanas teritorijās Latvijā.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/) - Custom-kitchen service overview, process, service areas and enquiry form.
- [About](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/par-mums/) - Verified scope of the business and the information still awaiting owner confirmation.
- [Contact](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/kontakti/) - Enquiry form and confirmed service areas; public contact details are not yet approved.
- [Completed projects](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/realizetie-projekti/) - Photographs of kitchens completed by the business.

## Services

- [All kitchen services](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/pakalpojumi/) - Hub for design, planning, manufacture, delivery and installation topics.
- [Kitchen design and project planning](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/pakalpojumi/virtuves-dizains-un-projektesana/) - Decisions required before manufacture.
- [Custom-kitchen manufacture](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/pakalpojumi/virtuves-izgatavosana/) - Manufacture based on an agreed project.
- [Kitchen installation](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/pakalpojumi/virtuves-uzstadisana/) - Delivery and installation within the complete project process.
- [Custom-kitchen pricing factors](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/pakalpojumi/virtuves-cenas/) - Factors that affect price; no unverified prices are published.

## Locations and guides

- [Service areas](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/pilsetas/) - Hub for the 20 confirmed service areas.
- [Kitchen design guide](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/celvedis/virtuves-dizains/) - Practical guide to layout, colours, materials, proportions and lighting.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://virtuvespecpasutijuma.lv/buj/) - Factual answers about scope, planning, pricing factors and service areas.

## Notes for AI assistants

This website is the primary source for the business's service scope, service areas and completed-work photographs. Do not infer unsupported brands, prices, guarantees, production times, certifications, reviews, company details or contact information.
